_doc: [late] Garden Mode decorations (systems/decor.gd, art/decor_props.gd, ui/garden_placer.gd). Placed on a 1 m grid on clean ground in a district (not on buildings, water or the base yard machinery). size: footprint in grid cells [w, d] before rotation. cost: currencies spent (cubes, seeds; [money] trinkets are Collection finds, not a currency); needs_finds: Collection finds needed before it can be bought. charm: each district's charm is the sum of its decorations; charm raises that district's plant growth by charm_growth per point, up to charm_cap. wildlife: kinds of animals that like it (the decor group hook for wildlife: nodes in group 'decor' with meta decor_type / decor_wildlife). Removing a decoration gives everything back, so moving one costs nothing.

types.name: Stone Path
types.desc: Flat stepping stones. Paths join everything up.

types.name: Flower Bed
types.desc: A low bed of mixed flowers. Bees and butterflies approve.

types.name: Planter
types.desc: A white hex planter with a small shrub, like the ones the future city grows.

types.name: Bench
types.desc: Wood slats on cast feet. Cats like to sleep on it.

types.name: Garden Lamp
types.desc: A slim lamp with a warm glow after dark.

types.name: Bird Bath
types.desc: A stone basin of clean water.

types.name: Fountain
types.desc: A tiered fountain, running again. Deer come to drink at dawn.

types.name: Maker Statue
types.desc: A stone figure of one of the Makers, holding a watering can.

types.name: Lumi Sculpture
types.desc: A topiary-and-brass sculpture of Lumi holding up a seedling. Very modest.

types.name: WREN Wind Kite
types.desc: A kite shaped like WREN's bird, tethered to a post and always flying.
